title: Translate the scan head into the dotted line
goal: Use transform to translate the display position of elements and retain the original layout space.
summary: scanning head is on the far left side of the track. Move it along the cross rail to the dotted mark.
tasks: Set transform to .scanner-head so that it moves 80px horizontally to the right.
preview, let the scan head coincide with the dotted frame and maintain the vertical position.

example.note: The map marker moves up 6px from its original position. translateY changes the vertical position, with negative values ​​toward the top of the page.

hint: The dotted line is on the right side of the scan head. Use translateX(80px) to move right along the horizontal axis, and translateY to move out of the track vertically.
